description: The line plot illustrates how the Area Under the Curve (AUC), expressed as a percentage, varies with respect to the parameter 'N', which ranges from 0 to 20 along the x-axis in increments of 5. The y-axis, labeled “AUC (%)”, spans from 75 to 100, also marked at 5-unit intervals. Five distinct lines, each with a unique color and marker style, represent different experimental conditions or datasets. The light blue line with circle markers begins at approximately 94% AUC when N=0, rises to a peak of 99% at N=10, and then gradually declines to 94% at N=20. The orange line with square markers starts at 87% AUC at N=0, increases to 98% at N=10, and then decreases to 92% at N=20. The green line with star markers starts at 86% AUC, steadily climbs to 94% at N=15, and remains flat at 94% through N=20. The magenta line with inverted triangle markers begins at 80% AUC, sharply rises to 96% at N=10, and then drops precipitously to 81% at N=20. The yellow line with diamond markers starts at 84% AUC, rises to a peak of 95% at N=15, and then slightly declines to 94% at N=20. All lines exhibit non-monotonic behavior, with most peaking around N=10 or N=15 before declining or stabilizing.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the variable 'N' and the percentage of AUC across multiple datasets or conditions. The x-axis is labeled 'N' and spans values from 0 to 20, marked at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled 'AUC (%)' and ranges from 75 to 100, marked at intervals of 5. The light blue line with circle markers shows a consistent increase from approximately (0, 94) to a peak at (10, 99), followed by a slight decline to (20, 94). The orange line with square markers starts at (0, 87), peaks at (10, 98), and ends at (20, 92). The green line with star markers begins at (0, 86), rises steadily to (15, 94), and stabilizes at (20, 94). The magenta line with inverted triangle markers starts low at (0, 80), peaks sharply at (10, 96), and then collapses to (20, 81). The yellow line with diamond markers starts at (0, 84), rises to a peak at (15, 95), and then slightly decreases to (20, 94).
